page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal notes in the left margin, beside the lines "bus regis", "pus Sufanna", "fpectatae", "le libera-", "bus presbyteris", "majores" and "separari".

main_text.p: fore: Fidesque distis affuit,ita ut minimè Dan. 13.eorum vultus comparabiles haberentur, qui imperialibus impendiis procurabantur. Igitur a rege in honore & gratia adhi-biti, prudentia & disciplina brevi omni-bus regis proximis antelati. Peridem tem-Sufannapus Sufanna quaedam loachim nupta, a Danie- le libera- ta.spectatae foemina pulchritudinis, a duo-bus presbyteris alaaxétp [?]appetita, cum impudicis non acquievisset,fallo crimine incessitur, iisdē presbyteris deferentibus,in remotis locis adolescētem cum ea deprehensum, sed illum juvenili alacritate senu manus effugisse. Ita presbyteris fides habita, judicio populi Sufana damnatur. Quae cum secundum legem ad supplicium ducere-tur, Daniel tum annos natus xii. increpi-tis Iudaeis, quod innocentem mortí dedis-sent, reducere eam in judicium, caufamq; denuo audiri postulat. Enimvero multi-tudo Iudaeorum, quae tum aderat, non sine Domino existimans puerum contemptae aetatulae in hanc constantiâ prorupisse, fa-vore accommodato, in cöfilium reverti-tur. Initur denuo judicio. Danieli, ut inter bununq;majores natu residèret, delatum. Igitur atq; alt. tum. Sig.separari accusatores jubet: bununquæ ex eis interrogat,

page.notes: The first word of the page continues from the previous page and is a fragment ("fore:"). Printed ornaments (asterisks after "minim", "loachim" and "tum") are not text and are left out. The Greek marginal word beside "bus presbyteris" is badly blurred and read only in part; it is marked [?]. The lower-left notes "atq; alt." and "tum. Sig." are doubtful. "bununq;" appears in the text and in the margin and is doubtful in both places. "Dan. 13." and the other marginal notes are read from a weak scan.
